title.value: BALAUR: Language Model Pretraining with Lexical Semantic Relations
title.justification: The title of the paper is 'BALAUR: Language Model Pretraining with Lexical Semantic Relations'
title.quote: BALAUR: Language Model Pretraining with Lexical Semantic Relations

extractions.description: The paper introduces BALAUR, a novel method for improving the generalization of pretrained language models (LMs) on tasks involving lexical semantic relations (LSRs), specifically hypernymy and hyponymy. BALAUR models LSRs directly in the LM’s hidden states throughout pretraining, enhancing performance on hypernymy-informed tasks.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper is focused on improving language models using lexical semantic relations. While it can be used for downstream tasks related to sustainability, it is not the central theme of the paper.
